question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Criticise
solution: The correct answer is '**Praise**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Criticise**' is '**Praise**'. • **Criticise**: to say what is bad or wrong with somebody/something. (किसी की निंदा या आलोचना करना) • *Example: The doctor was **criticized** for not sending the patient to the hospital.* • **Praise**: to say that somebody/something is good and should be admired. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की प्रशंसा करना, उसे सराहना) • *Example: The fireman was **praised** for his courage.* **Correct Answer:__** *Praise.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Disappoint**: to make somebody sad because what he/she had hoped for has not happened or is less good, interesting, etc. then he/she had hoped. [आशा के अनुरूप श्रेष्ठ, रुचिकर आदि न होना, (किसी को) निराश करना, हताश करना] • **Prevent**: to stop something happening or to stop somebody doing something. (किसी बात को होने न देना या किसी को कोई काम करने से रोक देना) • **Forgive**: to stop being angry towards somebody for something that he/she has done wrong. (किसी को क्षमा या माफ़ करना) 42:T67b, The correct answer is '**catches**'.
